svg.title: CH-R2 - 2-wire resistance meter (Phase 1)

text.tspan: GP14 / GP15: output HIGH = range on, INPUT (high-Z) = off.
Only one range is active at a time. Turn-off: drive LOW 20 ms, then INPUT.
R_dut = R_REF · V_node / (V_top − V_node) 100 nF on GP27, GP28 to AGND.
